title: Santurce Design Studio
description: A creative agency occupying a converted warehouse needed light control that could flex between presentation mode and open studio. Minimalist roller shades on a continuous fascia system run the full length of the north-facing clerestory windows, delivering even, diffused light ideal for color-critical work. The matte white fabric was chosen to reflect rather than absorb the industrial ceiling's ambient light.
